description: This file defines the Tween class and related effects for jQuery, handling animations and easing functions.

classes.name: Tween
classes.description: Represents an animation tween for a DOM element, managing property transitions.

methods.name: Tween.prototype.init
methods.description: Initializes a Tween instance with element, options, property, end value, easing, and unit.

methods.name: Tween.prototype.cur
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the property being animated.

methods.name: Tween.prototype.run
methods.description: Advances the tween to a specific percentage of completion, updating the property accordingly.
